_doc: NAN-5762: intentional exceptions to the e2e layout invariants (nanosiem-web/tests/e2e/ui/layout.mjs).

Each entry: id, checks (overflow | escape | clipped | overdrawn | any), at least one of selector (CSS the offending element itself matches: for overflow the scroll container, for escape / clipped the escaping element, for overdrawn the covered control), within (CSS of the element or any ancestor) and container (CSS the card / panel matches), optional surfaces (keys of e2e/coverage/ui-surfaces.json; default every page), and a reason.
An entry for a bug that is being fixed sets temporary: true and issue: NAN-<id>, and is removed when that fix merges (scripts/release/check-e2e-coverage.py lists every temporary entry on each run).

entries.reason: Data tables with more columns than fit scroll sideways inside their own table scroller by design: SOC tables keep every column instead of wrapping cells. Never the main pane or a panel / dialog.
Code, queries, VRL and raw events keep their line breaks and scroll sideways rather than soft-wrapping (wrapping would change what an analyst copies).
The theme picker is a sideways-scrolling swatch strip by design. The 'Scroll themes right' affordance sits beside the strip, never over a swatch (NAN-5836), so overdrawn is not allowed here.
The ATT&CK coverage matrix keeps all 14 tactic columns side by side, like the ATT&CK Navigator; it scrolls sideways inside its own pane by design.
